description: Check an options book (existing or proposed legs) the way a broker's options desk would: covered, cash-secured, spread or naked; margin requirement under FINRA Rule 4210; cash-account limits; required approval level; early-assignment risk around ex-dividend dates; pin risk; auto-exercise of expiring in-the-money longs and the capital it needs; max loss; and net Greeks. Returns approve / approve_with_warnings / reject with reasons. Price: $0.01.

buying_power.description: Broker-reported option or stock buying power, if known.

cash.description: Settled cash; cash accounts need it for cash-secured puts.

options_level.description: Approved level at the broker (typical scale 1 to 4).

shares_held.description: Shares of the underlying held long (covers short calls).

as_of.description: Date of the check (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to today in New York.

policy.description: Overrides: pin_band_pct, max_requirement_pct_of_equity, max_delta_dollars_pct_of_equity, assignment_dte, low_extrinsic.

dividend.description: Dividend per share for that date.

name: options_risk_check
title: Options risk and margin check
